title: Decision support framework for mitigating failure demand in healthcare
abstract: arXiv:2611.32139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Failure demand studies in healthcare are, by nature, observational field studies conducted by social scientists. Historically, these practices have neglected any follow-on analysis by economists, data analysts, or mathematicians. In this paper, we argue that the mitigation of failure demand can only be effectively navigated through analytical cost-benefit modelling conducted in conjunction with a comprehensive uncertainty-sensitivity analysis. Using an existing failure demand field study as the starting point, we demonstrate how such a follow up analysis can be conducted and formulate a pragmatic decision support methodological framework that can be disseminated to the researchers and practitioners throughout the broad healthcare field. The framework emanates from classical cost-benefit modelling that is then supplemented with Monte Carlo simulation in combination with the groundbreaking Simulation Decomposition (SimDec) method. translated_title: 医疗保健领域缓解失败需求的决策支持框架
translated_abstract: 医疗保健领域的“失败需求”研究本质上是社会科学工作者开展的观察性实地研究。从历史上看，这些实践一直忽视了由经济学家、数据分析师或数学家进行的后续分析。本文认为，只有通过与全面的不确定性-敏感性分析相结合的分析性成本效益建模，才能有效应对失败需求的缓解问题。以一项现有的失败需求实地研究为出发点，我们展示了如何开展此类后续分析，并构建了一个务实的决策支持方法论框架，该框架可推广至整个医疗保健领域的研究人员和从业人员。该框架源于经典的成本效益建模，随后辅以蒙特卡洛模拟，并结合了开创性的模拟分解方法。
tldr: 本文提出一个将成本效益建模、蒙特卡洛模拟与模拟分解方法相结合、并辅以不确定性-敏感性分析的决策支持框架，用于帮助医疗保健领域有效缓解失败需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision support framework combining cost-benefit modelling, Monte Carlo simulation, the Simulation Decomposition (SimDec) method, and comprehensive uncertainty-sensitivity analysis to effectively mitigate failure demand in healthcare.
